title: Mazda RX-7 Engines by Year (1979–1995)
description: Every factory engine in the US Mazda RX-7 by year, 1979–1995: the 12A and 13B two-rotor rotaries, the Turbo II and the sequential twin-turbo 13B-REW of the third generation.
intro: Mazda sold the RX-7 in the US from 1979 to 1995, always with a two-rotor Wankel rotary engine. Rotary displacement is quoted for both rotors. There was no official 1992 US model.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: First generation (FB)
intro: The 1.1 12A rotary, with the fuel-injected 1.3 13B in the 1984–1985 GSL-SE.

generations.name: Second generation (FC)
intro: The 13B, naturally aspirated and as the turbocharged Turbo II from 1987.
